method: E13_norm_no_cldice's trained model (E12_norm_ccdf_cldice_cv without the clDice term, normalised v3), sampled with E12's selected CCDF configuration, fixed (one-call start, t0 = 2, no projection). No retraining, no sweep
_ablation: sampler-controlled loss ablation of E12: the network weights are E13_norm_no_cldice's; the sampler configuration is E12's selected.json, so the only difference from E12 is the training loss (E13_norm_no_cldice's own val sweep picked the plain 15-step chain, which confounded E13_norm_no_cldice vs E12)
_normalization: every image the model sees (train, val, test) is fpr.data.normalization.normalize()d: train/val from script 10's copies, repair normalises its input on the fly. Its output is a normalised print, evaluated as stored against the normalised original and gallery (evaluate.py --rec-normalized, set by run_eval.py from output_normalized)

model._inputs: x_t (1) + cond: normalised damaged print, mask, cos 2theta, sin 2theta (4)

inference._note: checkpoint is relative to the repo root (E13_norm_no_cldice's EMA weights at step 100,000); selected.json = E12's selected configuration
